title: Biden signs Ukraine Democracy Defense Lend-Lease Act of 2022
body:
On 9 May 2022 United States President Joe Biden signed the Ukraine Democracy Defense Lend-Lease Act of 2022 into law at the White House. The act lets the president use a military lend-lease programme to transfer weapons, military equipment, medicine and food to Ukraine more quickly, with Ukraine expected to pay for these items later.

The act revived the approach of the wartime lend-lease programme, which was used during the Second World War to rapidly arm allies of the United States. The Senate passed the bill unanimously on 6 April 2022, and the House of Representatives approved it on 28 April 2022. The signing took place on the day Russia marks Victory Day, the anniversary of the end of the Second World War in Europe.

The law was intended to shorten the time needed to deliver supplies to Ukraine by reducing the procedures that otherwise apply to transfers of defence articles. It came in addition to existing American security assistance to Ukraine, which was being supplied through presidential drawdowns and through funding approved by Congress after the invasion began.
